newsitem.title: USA: Keystone Auto names Charles Hogarty CEO.
newsitem.headline: Keystone Auto names Charles Hogarty CEO.

text.p: Keystone Automotive Industries Inc said Wednesday Charles Hogarty has been named chief executive officer to replace Virgil K. Benton II, who resigned as chairman and chief executive May 23 to pursue other opportunities.
The company said Ronald Brown has been named chairman of the board in Benton's place. Brown, 59, had been president of North Star Plating, which Keystone acquired in March, it said.
Hogarty, 56, has been president, chief operating officer and a director of Keystone since 1987, the company said. He joined the company in 1960.
The company said Kim D. Wood has been named president of the North Star unit. Wood, 40, had been vice president of North Star since 1982.
